propositions: set_project accepts invalid project keys (empty string, leading digits, trailing whitespace, malformed syntax) with no validation and persists them to projects.json, causing downstream failures in reconciler fan-out
set_project must validate the project key using fetcher._validate_project_key before atomic_write and reject invalid keys with a ValueError, leaving projects.json unwritten
remove_project must also validate the project key before mutation to prevent invalid keys from triggering removal logic
invalid-key ValueError must be mapped to RebarError(returncode=2) at the _lib_ops seam so CLI and MCP write tools surface a clean non-zero error without traceback
fetcher._validate_project_key regex and logic must be reused without duplication across set_project and remove_project
